Sofia, the stuck Hagerstown driver was at Door 4B. You posted about it in #coastal-random on 13 Oct: a Covey & Lark Retail driver was arguing with the guard shack over a barcode scanner. I replied in the thread on your message.

Covey & Lark Retail was renamed Pellow Home Living in February. Your 13 Oct post used the old name.
